notes:
This is an early build, released to consoles set to Latest Updates.

Deep sleep now works on the charger too, handheld. Docked, the console still just turns
the screen off. With deep sleep on, a sleep that only turns the screen off (the power
button in a game, or docked) now disconnects your Bluetooth controllers after a minute,
so they turn off instead of staying on all night; press a button on one to connect it
again. Deep sleep also waits while a Wind Waker HD build or a PC game download or install
is running.

Ports have a new option in a game's Controllers screen: Right stick as mouse. On, the
right stick moves the mouse pointer from the start and R3 clicks; Capture turns the mouse
off and on. Capture's mouse in a port now shows the pointer; before, it moved but could
not be seen.

The Wind Waker HD port is updated to the newest SwitchWakerHD, with its fixes for island
names drawing wrong as you arrive and for sounds and music going silent in busy moments,
like the storm and sea battles. Your game keeps working as it is; on the web page,
Rebuild now gets the update (about 35 minutes, plugged in).

Updating the Retro Rewind pack no longer deletes your Retro Rewind save or the files you
added to its Patches and MyStuff folders.

Docked on a TV, the home screen header no longer cuts the IP address down to one
character when every readout is on.

Deep sleep on the charger was tested for five minutes on one console, not overnight. The
controller disconnect was tested without a Bluetooth controller connected. The Wind Waker
HD update was checked on its title screen.

stable.notes:
The 2.41 changes, now on the Stable channel. If this console was on 2.40.0,
it also gets the whole 2.40 series, summed up at the end.

This update carries a new boot script: the console restarts once for the
update and once more on its own about a minute after the first boot. Do not
power off while it says part 2 of 2.

The SD card's fastest mode (DDR200) is now used on Samsung cards only, as
Switchroot does. Other cards run in the standard mode: if yours used the
fast mode, games load a little slower, but SanDisk cards, which cannot run
it reliably on the Switch, no longer get read errors under load. If a
Samsung card gives read errors, turn DDR200 off in the SCCM Retro app's Boot
settings.

The SCCM Retro app on the Homebrew menu is now one app: Launch SCCM Retro,
Launch in Safe Mode (stock clocks and voltages, once), Options (WiFi and
Bluetooth, boot settings, auto launch), and installing or removing SCCM
Retro on an SD card. The separate installer and calibration apps are
removed.

Swap A and B now applies only to Gen1Recomp and Moonlight, the two games
that offer it.

New background: Arcade, in Settings, Display and Sound, Appearance.

From 2.40.0, also: the console boots in about 28 seconds instead of about
50; Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask, and Mario Kart Wii as a native port
with Retro Rewind online, on Ports and Apps; a PC Games tab for Windows
games; auto save for RetroArch, 3DS and PS2 games; Wii U, GameCube, WiFi
and volume button fixes; and a security fix to install permissions.
